tensura.race.human.description: A physically weak but populous race that relies on technology and numbers rather than brute force. Their low magicule count means magic users are rare, and few people possess skills. Humans therefore excel at the Aura Fighting Method, known as Battlewill, which turns their aura into practical strength in combat.
tensura.race.beastfolk.description: A demi-human race able to shift between their true animal forms and a more humanlike shape. Their bestial traits grant exceptional strength, speed, and resilience, while keen senses make them capable hunters. Many fight by combining instinct with technique, drawing on powerful bodies rather than relying solely on magic.
tensura.race.slime.description: A type of Specter among monster races, Slimes have pliable bodies that can absorb and dissolve many substances. Their simple instincts often leave them passive, but threats can provoke startling ferocity. By consuming other matter, a Slime can gain useful resistances and abilities, making even this modest form a foundation for evolution.
tensura.race.wight.description: A skeletal undead monster that has become a demi-spiritual life-form, a Wight is sustained by magicules rather than ordinary flesh. Its body can endure hazards that would trouble the living, yet sunlight weakens it considerably. With experience and accumulated power, a Wight may develop a will of its own and rise beyond a mindless skeleton.
tensura.race.ghoul.description: Created through Blood Raise, Ghouls are undead thralls animated from the dead and bound to a master's command. Their vampiric nature grants unnatural endurance, but direct sunlight severely weakens them. Though initially lacking independence, a Ghoul can serve well in darkness, where its tireless body fears neither hunger nor fatigue.
tensura.race.giant.description: A race of powerful Majin, Giants are renowned for immense physical strength and natural Magic Resistance. Their towering frames let them wield heavy weapons and dominate close combat, while their sturdy bodies endure punishing blows. Skills can further increase their size or strength, making a Giant formidable even without elaborate spellcraft.
tensura.race.dwarf.description: A sprite race descended from Earth elementals, Dwarves are short in stature but formidable in resolve. Their endurance, discipline, and skill at arms make them steadfast soldiers, while their close ties to the earth lend a practical understanding of stone and metal. They are far more than their size suggests.
